skill_yaml:
skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
phases:
- id: approach_via
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: world
    offset:
    - 0.5
    - 0.0
    - 0.4
    tolerance: 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
- id: approach_goal
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: goal_marker
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.2
    tolerance: 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
- id: descend_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: goal_marker
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current

skill: obstacle_reach
dsl_version: 2
phases:
- id: approach_via
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: world
    offset:
    - 0.5
    - 0.0
    - 0.4
    tolerance: 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
- id: approach_goal
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: goal_marker
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.2
    tolerance: 0.05
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
- id: descend_goal
  type: descend
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_goal
    entity: goal_marker
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: align_axis
      axis:
      - 0.0
      - 0.0
      - 1.0
      align_with: world_z
      tolerance: 0.1
  parameters:
    descend_offset_x:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.01
      - 0.01
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.x
        mode: add
    descend_offset_y:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.01
      - 0.01
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.y
        mode: add
    descend_offset_z:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - -0.01
      - 0.01
      default: 0.0
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: add
    descend_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.05
      - 0.3
      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
    descend_tolerance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.03
      default: 0.02
      binds_to:
      - path: termination.pose_tolerance
        mode: replace

  type: descend
